summary: PO of 09.06.2021, section 8: a 9-ECTS compulsory language-practice module (MA01 Vertiefungsmodul Sprachpraxis), a 33-ECTS specialization in one sub-discipline (cultural studies, linguistics or literature), a 33-ECTS supplementary area (options A, B or C), a 15-ECTS elective module and the 30-ECTS thesis module. The sub-discipline and option choices cannot be expressed in the checklist; eCampus lists all subject modules in one area, checked at 4 modules for options A and B, while the option B internship and option C study abroad are not in this list.

categories.name: Language practice
categories.note: Compulsory MA01 Vertiefungsmodul Sprachpraxis (9 ECTS): take three English 3 exercise classes. Parallel groups of the same exercise are alternatives; pick one group per exercise.

categories.name: Specialization and supplementary modules
categories.note: Specialization: one advanced module (15 ECTS) and one research module (18 ECTS) in one sub-discipline; supplement: option A (advanced plus research module of a second sub-discipline), B (advanced module plus a 9-ECTS second-language module plus a 9-ECTS internship) or C (advanced module plus 18-ECTS study abroad). Four is the number of modules from this area for option A and for option B (its second advanced module plus French or Spanish); the option B internship and option C study abroad (MA16) are not in this list, so an option C student only has 3 modules here.

po: Master English and American Studies (MA EAS)
